title: Flow Double-Click Add Node
description: Double-click flow canvas to search functions, preview ghost node with highlight, Enter to add top suggestion, chevron for full list with hover preview.
summary: Compacted flow spotlight suggestion rows to a single line (primary label + optional inline summary) instead of stacked name/summary columns. Labels and chrome now follow DAG draw LOD: abbreviation at compact/detail, name at normal/micro, icon at overview, summary inline at detail/micro, with tighter panel sizing per tier. Added flowCatalogueItemLodDisplay helper and vitest coverage. All 98 @semio-tech/flow-react tests pass.
